newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla cattle moderately traded at $63-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla cattle moderately traded at $63-USDA.

text.p: Trade moderate in the panhandle area Tuesday.
Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 11,600 slaughter steers and 6,400 heifers; 66,300 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 18,900 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 63.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 62.50. Pen Select and Choice 1-3 1250 lb Holsteins 57.00.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 63.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 62.50. Confirmed 18,000 Week Ago 54,400 Year Ago 700
Wk to date 66,300 Week Ago 114,400 Year Ago 18,700.
